= index-escapes(1)
:manmanual: Index tests
:mansource: acdc
:acdc-index:

== Name
index-escapes - escaped brackets

== Synopsis
Index terms.

== Description

:source-highlighter: syntect
:term: Expanded \] term

(({term}))

[subs="macros,attributes"]
(({term}))

[subs=-macros]
((Disabled \] term))

[source,text,subs=+macros]
----
((Code \] term))
link:https://example.org[((Code link \] term))]
----

pass:m[((Pass \] term))]

[subs="macros,quotes,replacements"]
((*Late \] bold*))

pass:m[((Pass repeated \\] term))]

indexterm2:[{term}]

[subs="macros,attributes"]
indexterm2:[{term}]

[subs="macros,attributes"]
link:https://example.org[((Linked {term}))]

[index]
